script = '''
import fitz  # PyMuPDF
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io
import json

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)

# --- Part 1: Extract text from ALL pages ---
all_text = []
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    all_text.append({"page": i + 1, "text": text})

# --- Part 2: OCR on the first page ---
first_page = doc[0]
# Render first page to image at 300 DPI
pix = first_page.get_pixmap(dpi=300)
img_bytes = pix.tobytes("png")
img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))

# Save the first page image for reference
img.save("output/first_page.png")

# Perform OCR
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

doc.close()

# --- Output ---
print("=" * 60)
print("EXTRACTED TEXT (PyMuPDF - all pages)")
print("=" * 60)
for entry in all_text:
    print(f"\\n--- Page {entry['page']} ---")
    preview = entry['text'][:2000] if len(entry['text']) > 2000 else entry['text']
    print(preview)
    if len(entry['text']) > 2000:
        print(f"... [truncated, total {len(entry['text'])} chars]")

print("\\n" + "=" * 60)
print("OCR TEXT (Tesseract - first page only)")
print("=" * 60)
print(ocr_text[:3000] if len(ocr_text) > 3000 else ocr_text)
if len(ocr_text) > 3000:
    print(f"... [truncated, total {len(ocr_text)} chars]")

print("\\n" + "=" * 60)
print(f"Summary: {len(all_text)} pages extracted, OCR text length: {len(ocr_text)} chars")
print(f"First page image saved to: output/first_page.png")
'''

await make_directory("./output")
await write_file("./extract_pdf.py", script)
print("Script written.")

result = await run_command("python ./extract_pdf.py")
print(result)

save_script = '''
import fitz
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io

full_text = ""
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    full_text += f"\\n{'='*40} Page {i+1} {'='*40}\\n"
    full_text += page.get_text()

# OCR on first page
first_page = doc[0]
pix = first_page.get_pixmap(dpi=300)
img_bytes = pix.tobytes("png")
img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

doc.close()

with open("output/handbook_extracted_text.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(full_text)

with open("output/handbook_first_page_ocr.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(ocr_text)

print(f"Full extracted text saved: {len(full_text)} chars")
print(f"OCR text saved: {len(ocr_text)} chars")
'''
